# About 

Investigating what reneging looks like for different months across trusts. Specifically, looking for instances where we have negative reneges, a paradoxical instance of seemingly more people being treated from that month's bucket than are in the bucket. 

```{r}
#| label: set-up

library(NHSRtt)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)

theme_set(theme_bw() + theme(legend.position="top",legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm")
))
```

We use the pins 24 month data for speediness.

```{r}
#| label: data-read-pins

# NB if want to use different data range will need NHSRtt::get_rtt_data but takes a while
cache_file <- "data/rtt_24months.rds"

# forcing manual running (going inside the impossible if statement) if doing for the first 
# time or you want to reload
if(0==1){
  board <- pins::board_url(c(
    rtt_24months = "https://connect.strategyunitwm.nhs.uk/rtt-data/24-months/"
  ))

  rtt_24months_tbl <- board |>
    pins::pin_read("rtt_24months")

  saveRDS(rtt_24months_tbl, cache_file)
} else {
  rtt_tbl <- readRDS(here::here(cache_file))  # cache_file already contains "data/"
}
```

We only take the largest of the trusts. The calculation used is
```r
    mutate(prev_Incomplete = lag(Incomplete, 1)) |> 
    mutate(Reneges = case_when(
        months_waited_id==0 ~ Referrals - Complete - Incomplete,
        months_waited_id>0 ~  prev_Incomplete - Complete - Incomplete
    )) |> 
```

Which in words is (or should be!) that the number of reneges is the monthly inflow minus the outflow.

```{r}
#| label: plot-observed-reneges

# rtt_tbl |> count(type)
# rtt_tbl |> filter(period=="2023-12-01", months_waited_id==0)

# rtt_tbl <- rtt_tbl |> filter(trust=="NORTH BRISTOL NHS TRUST")
trusts_to_use <- rtt_tbl |>
    group_by(trust) |> 
    summarise(value=max(value)) |> 
    filter(value>20000 | trust %in% c("NORTH BRISTOL NHS TRUST","UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS PLYMOUTH NHS TRUST")) |> 
    pull(trust)
renege_tbl <- rtt_tbl |> 
    filter(trust %in% trusts_to_use) |> 
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=type,values_from=value, values_fill=0) |> 
    group_by(specialty,period, trust, period_id) |> 
    arrange(months_waited_id) |> 
    mutate(prev_Incomplete = lag(Incomplete, 1)) |> 
    mutate(Reneges = case_when(
        months_waited_id==0 ~ Referrals - Complete - Incomplete,
        months_waited_id>0 ~  prev_Incomplete - Complete - Incomplete
    )) |> 
    ungroup()

renege_tbl <- renege_tbl |>
    mutate(specialty = fct_relevel(specialty,
      function(x) c(
        x[!grepl("^Other - ", x)],
        x[ grepl("^Other - ", x)]
      )
    )) |> 
    mutate(specialty = fct_rev(specialty)) |> 
    mutate(specialty = fct_relevel(specialty,"Total",after=0L)) 

signed_sqrt_trans <- scales::trans_new(
  name = "signed_sqrt",
  transform = function(x) sign(x) * sqrt(abs(x)),
  inverse = function(x) sign(x) * x^2
)
signed_cubert_trans <- scales::trans_new(
  name = "signed_cubert",
  transform = function(x) sign(x) * (abs(x))^(1/3),
  inverse = function(x) sign(x) * x^3
)
renege_tbl |> 
    ggplot(aes(x=Reneges, y=fct_rev(factor(months_waited_id)))) + 
    ggridges::geom_density_ridges() + 
    geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype=2) + 
    scale_x_continuous(trans=signed_sqrt_trans) + 
    labs(title = "Reneges by month - for the largest trusts in the data", 
    subtitle = paste0(
    "\nMonth 0 also lots of neg reneges which is expected",
    "\nMonth 12 looks odd - unsure why? "
    ),
    x="Reneges (sqrt axis)",
    y="Months Waited")
```

```{r}
#| label: parameter-tbl

# matching the table at end of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fjLtrm3kEuw
parameter_tbl <- renege_tbl |> 
    # exclude last one as has NAs
    filter(period!=max(period)) |> 
    group_by(specialty, trust, months_waited_id) |> 
    summarise(
        renege_parameter = sum(Reneges) / (sum(prev_Incomplete,na.rm=T) + sum(Referrals,na.rm=T)),
        capacity_parameter = sum(Complete) / (sum(prev_Incomplete,na.rm=T) + sum(Referrals,na.rm=T)),
        .groups="drop"
    )
if(0==1){
parameter_tbl |>
  DT::datatable(
    options = list(
      columnDefs = list(
        list(
          targets = which(names(parameter_tbl) == "trust") - 1,
          width = "200px"
        ),
        list(
          targets = which(sapply(parameter_tbl, is.numeric)) - 1,
          render = DT::JS("function(data) { return Math.round(data * 100) / 100; }")
        )
      )
    )
  )
}
```

# Look at specific examples - Plymouth & NBT

```{r}
#| label: check-specific-example
renege_tbl |> 
    filter(trust=="UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS PLYMOUTH NHS TRUST") |> 
    summarise(median_Reneges = median(Reneges), .by = c(specialty, months_waited_id, trust)) |>
    (\(d) ggplot(d, aes(x = months_waited_id, y = specialty, fill = median_Reneges)) + 
        geom_tile(col = "darkgrey") + 
        scale_fill_gradient2(
            low = "red",
            mid = "white",
            high = "blue",
            midpoint = 0,
            limits = c(-1, 1) * max(abs(d$median_Reneges), na.rm = TRUE)
        ) + 
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:12)
    )() + 
    labs(
    x = "Months Waited",
    y= "Specialty",
    fill = "Median Reneges",
    title = paste0("Trust: ", "UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS PLYMOUTH NHS TRUST")
    )



```

# Create Renege Plots for every large trust in the data
```{r}
#| label: create-renege-plots
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6

library(patchwork)

# Get all trusts from either table
all_trusts <- union(unique(renege_tbl$trust), unique(parameter_tbl$trust))

cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

purrr::walk(all_trusts, \(trust_name) {
    
    cat(paste0("## ", trust_name, "\n\n"))
    
    p1 <- renege_tbl |>
        filter(trust == trust_name, months_waited_id!=12) |>
        summarise(median_Reneges = median(Reneges), .by = c(specialty, months_waited_id, trust)) |>
        (\(d) ggplot(d, aes(x = months_waited_id, y = specialty, fill = median_Reneges)) +
            geom_tile(col = "darkgrey") +
            scale_fill_gradient2(
                low = "red", mid = "white", high = "blue",
                midpoint = 0,
                limits = c(-1, 1) * max(abs(d$median_Reneges), na.rm = TRUE)
            ) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:12) +
            labs(
                x = "Months Waited", y = "Specialty",
                fill = "Median Reneges",
                title = "Median Reneges",
                subtitle = trust_name
            )
        )()
    
    p2 <- parameter_tbl |>
        filter(trust == trust_name, months_waited_id!=12) |>
        (\(d) ggplot(d, aes(x = months_waited_id, y = specialty, fill = renege_parameter)) +
            geom_tile(col = "darkgrey") +
            scale_fill_gradient2(
                low = "red", mid = "white", high = "blue",
                midpoint = 0,
                limits = c(-1, 1) * max(abs(d$renege_parameter), na.rm = TRUE)
            ) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:12) +
            labs(
                x = "Months Waited", y = "Specialty",
                fill = "Renege Parameter",
                title = "Renege Parameter",
                subtitle = trust_name
            ) +
            geom_text(aes(label = round(renege_parameter, 2)))
        )()
    
    print(p1 + p2)
    
    cat("\n\n")
})

cat(":::\n")
```

UNIVERSITY HOSPITALS BIRMINGHAM NHS FOUNDATION TRUST is a good example of first month issues with negative reneges.
